preconditions.description: n is a positive integer between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The returned string has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned string is either '0' or '1'.
The first character of the returned string is '0'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[i-1] for i in range(1, n) if (i & (i - 1)) == 0)
postconditions.description: For every power-of-two index i (1-based), the character at i is the complement of the character at i-1.
